hooks.command: command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && python3 -I "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/boyscout.py" claude SessionStart || true
command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && python3 -I "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/boyscout.py" claude UserPromptSubmit || true
command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && python3 -I "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/boyscout.py" claude PostToolUse || true
command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && python3 -I "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/boyscout.py" claude PostToolUseFailure || true
command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && python3 -I "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/boyscout.py" claude SessionEnd || true
